description: Generated logic-grid puzzle (4 houses, 5 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
There are 4 houses in a row, numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber) and exactly one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara).

Clues:
1. Bruno lives in the red house.
2. Bruno lives in house number 2 (houses are numbered 1 to 4 from left to right).
3. The blue house is directly next to the amber house.
4. Ada lives in the amber house.
5. Dara lives in house number 4 (houses are numbered 1 to 4 from left to right).

Determine, for every house number, who lives there and what colour it is. This puzzle has exactly one solution.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour>
House 2: <name> - <colour>
(and so on)
